name: Jason Moran
description: The acclaimed American jazz pianist Jason Moran takes the stage at Casa da Música for what promises to be an unforgettable performance.
longDescription:
Jason Moran, the distinguished American jazz pianist and composer, will perform at Casa da Música on July 13, 2026. Known for his innovative approach to jazz, Moran's work often incorporates elements of hip-hop, classical music, and avant-garde influences. He has received numerous accolades, including a MacArthur Fellowship, and has released several critically acclaimed albums, establishing himself as a significant voice in contemporary jazz.

Attendees can expect a concert experience within the modern architectural setting of Casa da Música. The venue, designed by Rem Koolhaas, is renowned for its excellent acoustics and grand scale. The performance will feature Moran's distinctive piano style, which blends improvisation with structured compositions, appealing to both seasoned jazz enthusiasts and those new to the genre.

This is a ticketed event. Casa da Música is located in Boavista and is accessible via public transport. The Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) is directly adjacent to the venue. Several bus lines also serve the area.
